results.description:
Clara Maguire built her diner from nothing. Aged out of foster care with a trash bag of clothes and nine years of tip money, she turned a failed po'boy stand into the only honest meal on the Industrial Canal. Then a smiling loan shark decided her block was next — and sent men to sit in her booths until her customers stopped coming.

She's already tried the bank. The lawyer. The cops. When the polite options run out, Clara doesn't quit.

She escalates.

Saint has run the Bourbon Street Devils since he was nineteen, carving a kingdom out of a city that eats the weak. He doesn't do favors for civilians. But the woman who walks into his bar won't be rescued, won't be bought, and won't back down — she'd rather lose everything clean than owe any man a leash.

She's exactly the kind of trouble a dangerous man can't put down.

Kaplan wants her building. Saint wants her. And when the loan shark torches everything Clara loves, the most feared club in New Orleans goes to war — one burning block at a time.

He claims territory with blood and patience. She claims her own ground with a cast-iron skillet and a spine of steel. Together they're about to teach a man in a pressed shirt what happens when he reaches into the wrong neighborhood.

Book 1 in the Bourbon Street Devils MC Romance series. HEA guaranteed.
